netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
C Cf1 n1 n2
C Cf2 n2 VSS
NMOS M1 n3 n1 VSS VSS
NMOS M2 n4 n2 n3 VSS
R Rg n1 VDD
C Cg n1 VSS
L Ld VDD n4
C Cdeg n3 VSS
C Cout n4 VOUT1
C Cdeg2 n4 VSS
rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints—particularly S21_ripple_db and Idd_ma—by adding a source degeneration capacitor (Cdeg) in series with the source of M1, which enhances input matching and stabilizes gain ripple across the band while reducing current draw through improved transconductance linearity. The added Cdeg also supports better noise figure by reducing the input capacitance seen at the gate, indirectly aiding S11. This adjustment maintains the inductorless requirement and operates within device budget and sizing constraints.
